name: 1password
description: Connect a 1Password service account so other plugins' secrets can be saved as op:// secret references that Opulent resolves at runtime, instead of pasting the values. Only Opulent's resolver reads the service account token: it is never exported to a machine's shell or to an MCP server. Create the service account with read-only access (read_items) to only the vaults plugins may use; its vault grants are the whole scope.
